summary: Three-valued UI declaration at intake, declare verb, init and doctor, grandfathering (US-18901). Delivers AC-18901-1 to AC-18901-7. Estimated new node:test cases: 7. Order in the UX intake gate build: 2 of 6.
approach: Add --ui to rcf discover intake and a ui field to --input, writing the declaration onto journey.json beside the intakeClassification write; the declare verb with the lowering rule; interactive proposal from matchUiSignals and the non-interactive exit 2; rcf init writes the record with ui null; rcf doctor adds a notice, never drift; readJourneyRecord returning null is the grandfathered state the later stage reads.
deliverables: src/cli/intake.js and src/intake/orchestrator.js: --ui and input.ui, proposal and ask (none when nothing matched), exit 2 in --input mode whenever ui is absent
src/cli/journey.js: declare verb with --as-built and with --reason on lowering, creating the record on a tree that has none
src/cli/init.js: journey.json with ui null and declaredVia init
test/discovery/journey-declare.test.js: not-yet-built flags removed, bodies land (7 cases)
notes: Sized for one PR (DEFINE 2026-10-09, UX intake gate). Test estimate 7 new node:test cases in the suite named by the TS bound to US-18901; the suite's declarations land at DEFINE flagged not yet built and this FBS is done when none of them carries the flag and pnpm test is green. No freeze, no ack verbs. Binding rulings: three-valued declaration, answered not drawn, only central refuses for a missing wireframe, grandfather by absence of the record, no ack on D0, single reviewer. Not in any FBS here: a Journey tab in the viewer, a brief:journeySteps D1 check, a mark-complete refusal for unbound build specs.
title: Three-valued UI declaration at intake, declare verb, init and doctor, grandfathering
